grounding.observation: The repaired reference contract, current candidate5, cast inspection and exact337 correction authority are bound. The existing head, shirt and pose caches are identified rather than assumed to be low-poly proxies.
grounding.comparison: The admitted operation is a two-actor construction proof. Face/beard, horse finish and the complete moving crowd remain required downstream, not silently removed from the Director's goal.

expert_coverage.observation: Cloth form, intended-camera readability, animated layer contacts and reuse are given distinct requirements and failure conditions.
expert_coverage.comparison: The proposed three camera frames are useful early rejection controls, not sufficient reverse-contact or full-motion evidence. A surviving candidate still needs those later checks.

film_alignment.observation: The accepted Pashtun establishes supported forms and material separation; it does not require matching daylight pixel detail in the night shot.
film_alignment.comparison: A cylindrical or conical crown, embossed bodysuit or floating saddle will fail regardless of vertex count or improvement over the rejected candidate.

preferences.observation: The proof stays internal, preserves the high quality floor and avoids another technical-method handoff.
preferences.comparison: Neither a successful render nor a narrower clothing improvement permits presenting the known-defective face and horse as a finished deliverable.

reference_roles.observation: The PNG now carries accepted_quality with no temporal interval; the original video retains faithful_motion and its own interval.
reference_roles.comparison: Correcting the role does not erase the rejected plan. Costume is interpreted through same-film quality, while mounted pose/contact remains tied to the motion source.

method.observation: Inspected exact finite-envelope change: clamp negative float32 endpoint sine before fractional power; force zero outside support and reject nonfinite input. Eighteen numerical/operation/motion regressions pass. No other construction method changed.
method.comparison: The first attempt saved no candidate. This correction removes that numerical blocker only; cone/ring turban, embossed garment and unsupported-pad counterexamples still veto the next actual images.

interfaces.observation: Candidate5 is the appearance parent; primary horse/rider motion is not reapplied to a modified rest pose. Existing moving parents and garment keys are preserved. The code change affects only garment-envelope evaluation; candidate5 remains the parent and primary motion is not rebaked.
interfaces.comparison: Standing-only sash and pad fits are specifically unqualified at the crest. Any motion change later reopens these contacts and requires rest-basis reconciliation.

efficient_quality.observation: One leader and one nearby warrior are tested before crowd propagation, using three intended-frame images with one serial Blender worker.
efficient_quality.comparison: This reduces unproven replication, not the quality floor. No runtime saving percentage or successful output is inferred in advance.

authority.observation: Existing task is correction2/max4; the failed first native attempt, original rejected reference plan and exact337 approval are retained.
authority.comparison: No hidden retry, new spending, principal change or artistic acceptance. Motion is separately at newly approved7/max10 with incomplete prior extraction retained.

strongest_counterexample: A finite saved model can still look like a mannequin in a cone hat. The numerical tests cannot pass the visual gate; retain all first-challenge form and same-film counterexamples.
